integrity.claim_type: infinite-family exact formula with self-contained induction

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns cyclic-rotation BWT of dyadic iterates only, not a suffix BWT with a sentinel, arbitrary prefixes, or arbitrary morphisms.
The finite verification range is m <= 13, and constitutes a cross-check rather than a proof.
An undiscovered equivalent formula in literature or a computation outside the inspected corpus cannot be excluded.
title: Exact cyclic Burrows–Wheeler transform of dyadic period-doubling words
